title: Rewinded
description:
Faced with a planet depleted of resources, humanity turned to a desperate final measure: hyper-accelerating time to force Earth into a rapid state of regeneration. The reckless project failed, plunging the world into a state of 'zero entropy' where all energy decays into absolute nothingness.

You play as Gren, a state-of-the-art emergency protocol android built by humanity's finest minds for this exact apocalyptic scenario. Journey through dark facilities to wind back time, and forge a path to the genesis of the disaster to rewrite the future.

Gameplay & Key Features

• Puzzle-Platforming: Navigate a atmospheric 2D pixel art world where reflexes and logic collide. To progress, you must master the flow of time itself.

• Record and Replay Your Actions: Collaborate with your past self to overcome seemingly impossible obstacles. Record your movements and replay them to activate complex machinery in real-time. Let a past clone hold down a heavy switch, or time your jumps perfectly with a platform moved by your previous attempt.

• Intricate Interactive Hazards: Puzzle your way through high-tech facilities filled with moving elevators, pressure plates, toggle-buttons, teleportation portals, and spatial rifts that shift direction.
description_short: Rewinded is a puzzle platformer game where you play as an android robot rewinding time to undo a catastrophic project failure. Record your actions and replay them to complete your mission!
